name: CombatMeter
description: Real-time party DPS/HPS meter with role colours.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Live party DPS/HPS with role colours.
History — damage timeline with navigator and per-source table.

added: Every build you actually fight with in a run is now saved, not just the one you started with. Swap a piece of gear, change modules, respec talents, switch a Battle Imagine or edit your Psychoscope mid-run and each setup you then fought with is kept and shown as its own tab on the logs site.
Your equipped Battle Imagines are now part of the saved build, so changing one records a new setup.
Your Psychoscope (Deep Slumber) is saved with each build — season level, lines, socketed cards and node levels — so you can see exactly which psychoscope a fight was done with.
Uploaded runs now carry a timeline of when each setup became active, so the logs site can line a build up against what happened in the fight.
fixed: The saved build is now what you are actually wearing. It used to fall back to a saved loadout plan you were not using.
Changing a piece of gear with the Replace button is captured again — it used to go completely unnoticed.
Switching class mid-run no longer records a mixed-up build made half of one class and half of the other.
A talent change made just before a fight is now captured properly instead of sometimes recording the old tree.
Pausing the meter no longer stops it noticing an equipment change. Pausing stops the numbers, not the tracking.
An empty Battle Imagine pair that had not synced yet no longer creates a phantom extra setup.
